country.evidence_quote: TUD has been one of Germany’s Universities of Excellence since 2012 and is among the top-performing research institutions in the country. Excellence has initiated dynamic change at TUD: The university has become even more interdisciplinary and international, attracting outstanding researchers from all over the world. At the same time, this award inspires us to embody Excellence across the entire university.
